import unittest

import tomli


class DottedKeysRegressionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dotted_keys_can_share_an_implicit_parent(self) -> None:
        source = """\
[parent]
child.first = 1
child.second = 2
"""

        self.assertEqual(
            tomli.loads(source),
            {"parent": {"child": {"first": 1, "second": 2}}},
        )

    def test_dotted_key_cannot_extend_explicit_table(self) -> None:
        source = """\
[parent.child]
[parent]
child.value = 1
"""

        with self.assertRaises(tomli.TOMLDecodeError):
            tomli.loads(source)

    def test_dotted_key_cannot_extend_array_of_tables(self) -> None:
        source = """\
[[parent.child]]
[parent]
child.value = 1
"""

        with self.assertRaises(tomli.TOMLDecodeError):
            tomli.loads(source)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
